text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- The government proposed that the duration of obligatory military service should be reduced in November to nine months from twelve months.
-- A planned development programme at the police, including raising the number of policemen by 4,000 forints, is expected by the government to improve public security substantially.
-- The Finance Ministry said that the central budget's position in April was as it was expected.
